Cc: Alexis Turner <alexis.turner@brightwave.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: BrightWave reference for upcoming analyst briefing

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well — I'm organizing a short reference briefing for one of our analyst tracks (cloud inference / TCO for LLMs) and BrightWave came up as a strong example of a fast, cost-conscious rollout. Would BrightWave be open to a 30–40 minute call with one of our analysts? We're looking for both an executive perspective (value/metric-driven outcomes) and a technical 10–15 minute deep-dive (architecture, quantization choices, observed latency/cost improvements).

If BrightWave is available, preferred windows are May 10–14. We can be flexible on format (standalone call or as part of a panel). If you're ok, can you confirm who from BrightWave would join (CTO/Head of AI/Platform engineer)? We try to keep these high-signal and non-promotional.

Thanks — happy to loop in your advocacy contact if helpful.

Best,
Sam Ortiz
Principal Analyst, Infrastructure & Platforms
Gartner

Attachment: analyst_call_guidelines.pdf (attachment stub)

- Technical: Product lead + Platform engineer (can cover model selection, quantization, and deployment topology)

Sam — our availability window looks good for May 10–14. Alexis, any constraints? If May 12 or 13 work for you, we can lock a slot.

I've attached: draft_case_study_v0.3.pdf (internal draft), and a template NDA we can sign if necessary. We'll circulate a brief agenda (10m exec, 20m tech Q&A) and a one-pager for the analyst.
